jobs.title: Workday Financial Planning & HCM Implementation Project Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**


At e4health, we Empower Better Health. The e4health Team is on a relentless mission to care for those teams who care for others. We bring our passion, ingenuity, and expertise to every engagement. In joining our Team, we want your help to provide our customers with powerful solutions in the pursuit of quality, integrity, clinical and financial value across healthcare.


Our People make the difference. Serving more than 400 hospitals and health systems nationwide for nearly two decades, e4health provides solutions to tackle the toughest problems in healthcare with unmatched technology, mid\-revenue cycle, and operational expertise. e4health solutions streamline clinical, financial, and health information data and workflows, optimize coding, quality, and clinical documentation integrity processes, and address health IT operational challenges to deliver material results for healthcare organizations across the country. Learn more about us at www.e4\.health.

 **Position Summary**


The Workday Financial Planning \& HCM Implementation Project Manager will lead the planning, coordination, and execution of a large\-scale Workday implementation within a complex healthcare organization. This role will oversee project activities related to Workday Financial Planning and HCM, coordinating internal business and IT teams, Workday implementation partners, technical resources, and executive stakeholders.


The Project Manager will be responsible for maintaining project scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, and deliverables throughout the implementation lifecycle. The role will provide strong project governance and ensure that functional, technical, data, integration, testing, change management, training, and organizational readiness activities remain aligned toward successful deployment.


The ideal candidate will have experience managing enterprise ERP, financial systems, HRIS, or Workday implementations and be comfortable operating in a highly matrixed healthcare environment.

 **Key Responsibilities**

 **Project Leadership \& Governance**

* Lead the overall project management and implementation governance for Workday Financial Planning and HCM.
* Develop and maintain the integrated project plan, milestones, dependencies, deliverables, and critical path.
* Establish project governance, meeting structures, decision\-making processes, and escalation procedures.
* Coordinate project activities across Finance, HR, IT, Payroll, Accounting, clinical/operational stakeholders, and other business areas.
* Facilitate project steering committee meetings and provide regular status reporting to executive leadership.
* Ensure project objectives, scope, timelines, and expected outcomes remain clearly defined and understood.
* Monitor project progress and proactively identify schedule, resource, scope, and delivery concerns.

**Workday Implementation Management**

* Coordinate implementation activities across Workday Financial Planning and HCM workstreams.
* Partner with Workday implementation consultants and internal teams to establish and maintain implementation plans.
* Coordinate requirements gathering, design, configuration, data conversion, integrations, testing, reporting, training, and deployment activities.
* Ensure dependencies between Financial Planning, HCM, Payroll, Finance, and other systems are identified and actively managed.
* Coordinate decisions and approvals required to move workstreams through implementation milestones.
* Track configuration and design decisions and ensure appropriate documentation and stakeholder sign\-off.

**Project Planning \& Execution**

* Build and maintain detailed project schedules and workstream plans.
* Establish milestones and measurable deliverables for each phase of the implementation.
* Track progress against baseline schedules and identify potential delays before they affect critical milestones.
* Coordinate resources across internal teams and external implementation partners.
* Facilitate project working sessions and ensure action items are clearly assigned and tracked to completion.
* Maintain project documentation, status reports, meeting materials, decisions, and action logs.
* Coordinate project activities across multiple concurrent workstreams.

**Risk, Issue \& Dependency Management**

* Establish and maintain project RAID logs covering risks, assumptions, issues, and dependencies.
* Proactively identify implementation risks and develop mitigation and contingency plans.
* Escalate significant issues and decisions to appropriate leadership in a timely manner.
* Monitor dependencies between Workday, legacy applications, integrations, data conversion, reporting, and organizational readiness.
* Coordinate issue resolution across business, technical, and vendor teams.
* Track decisions that may impact scope, timeline, cost, or implementation readiness.

**Data, Integration \& Technical Coordination**

* Coordinate data conversion, cleansing, mapping, validation, and reconciliation activities.
* Work with technical teams to ensure integration development and testing remain aligned with the overall project schedule.
* Track dependencies between Workday and existing ERP, HR, payroll, financial, reporting, and other enterprise systems.
* Ensure technical deliverables are incorporated into the overall implementation plan.
* Coordinate technical testing, defect resolution, mock conversions, and production readiness activities.
* Partner with the Workday Financial Planning Technical Analyst and other technical resources to manage data\-related deliverables and dependencies.

**Testing \& Quality Management**

* Coordinate the overall testing strategy and schedule across functional and technical workstreams.
* Oversee planning for unit testing, system integration testing, regression testing, parallel testing, and user acceptance testing.
* Track test readiness, execution, defects, remediation, and sign\-off.
* Ensure business stakeholders have appropriate resources and timelines to complete testing.
* Monitor critical defects and issues that could affect deployment readiness.
* Coordinate final validation and business sign\-off prior to go\-live.

**Organizational Readiness \& Change Management**

* Coordinate change management, communications, training, and organizational readiness activities.
* Ensure impacted departments and stakeholders are identified and appropriately engaged.
* Coordinate training schedules, materials, communications, and readiness activities with project milestones.
* Monitor organizational readiness and escalate areas requiring additional support.
* Support development and execution of the go\-live and post\-go\-live stabilization strategy.

**Cutover \& Go\-Live**

* Lead development and maintenance of the integrated cutover plan.
* Coordinate final data conversion, integrations, configuration, testing, training, communications, and operational readiness activities.
* Establish go/no\-go criteria and coordinate readiness assessments.
* Facilitate go\-live decision\-making and executive readiness meetings.
* Coordinate command center activities during deployment and initial stabilization.
* Track post\-go\-live issues, priorities, and remediation activities through project closeout.

**Vendor \& Partner Management**

* Serve as a primary point of coordination between the health system and Workday implementation partners.
* Monitor vendor deliverables, milestones, commitments, and dependencies.
* Ensure vendor activities remain aligned with the approved project plan.
* Facilitate resolution of vendor\-related issues and escalations.
* Participate in contract, scope, change request, and deliverable discussions as appropriate.
* Monitor project resources and ensure appropriate expertise is available when needed.

**Financial \& Resource Management**

* Track project budget, resource utilization, and major project expenditures.
* Monitor internal and external project resources against approved plans.
* Identify resource constraints and develop recommendations for addressing capacity issues.
* Support management of scope changes and associated schedule, resource, and financial impacts.
* Ensure project changes follow established governance and approval processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Project Management, Finance, Healthcare Administration, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years of project management experience with progressively increasing responsibility.
* Experience leading complex enterprise system implementations.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple workstreams, teams, vendors, and competing priorities.
* Experience managing a Workday implementation, particularly Workday Financial Planning/Adaptive Planning and/or Workday HCM.
* Experience managing both financial and HR technology implementations.
* Healthcare or health system experience.
* Strong experience with project planning, scheduling, risk management, issue management, and executive reporting.
* Experience managing system implementation testing, data conversion, integrations, and go\-live activities.
* Strong communication, facilitation, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to operate effectively within a matrixed organization.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing large ERP, HRIS, financial planning, or enterprise application implementations.
* PMP, or similar project management certification.
* Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project management experience.
* Experience working directly with Workday implementation partners.
* Experience managing enterprise data conversion and integration workstreams.
* Experience with organizational change management and enterprise transformation initiatives.

**Travel**

* **10% Onsite but mainly remote**

 **401(k) ELIGIBILITY**


e4health offers a retirement benefits package including 401(k) with company match.

* Full\-time employees will be eligible to contribute to a 401(k)\-retirement account after successfully completing 90 days of employment.
* Part\-time employees will be eligible to contribute to a 401(k)\-retirement account after completing 250 hours of worktime.

  

The items listed below pertain to Full\-Time Employees only

 **BENEFITS:**


We offer an excellent salary, medical, dental, vision, life, short/long term disability insurance, and PTO policy.

  



**PHYSICAL DEMANDS OF THE ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**


Sitting, talking, hearing and near vision are required over 90% of the time. Feeling is required over 90% of the time and reaching is required about 50% of the time. The ability to travel to field sites may be required up to 15% of the time.

 **WORKING CONDITIONS WHILE PERFORMING ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**


Over 90% of the time is spent indoors, with protection from weather conditions. Exposure to noise levels that may be distracting or uncomfortable is present in only unusual situations.

 **PAY RANGE**


Pay range for this position is $D.O.E

  

e4health is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

  

At our organization, we believe in the principles of pay transparency to foster a fair and equitable workplace for all employees. In alignment with this commitment, we openly communicate salary ranges, bonus structures, and additional financial benefits associated with each position. We believe that transparency in compensation not only promotes trust and accountability but also helps mitigate wage gaps and biases. By providing clear and comprehensive information about compensation in our job descriptions, we aim to create a transparent and inclusive environment where all employees feel valued and respected. Join us in building a culture of fairness and transparency as we strive for excellence together.

jobs.title: Health Information Management Specialist
jobs.description:
The Health Information Management (HIM) Specialist is responsible for supporting the integrity, accuracy, confidentiality, availability, and security of patient health information across the Family of Companies. This position serves as a centralized resource for medical record management, release of information requests, record audits, record corrections, document management, regulatory compliance activities, and health information governance.
  

  

The HIM Specialist collaborates with clinical, operational, compliance, quality, legal, and technology teams to support the completeness, defensibility, and compliance of medical records with regulatory requirements, and is readily available to support quality care, audits, accreditation activities, government investigations, payer requests, and business operations.
**Essential Job Functions**

Medical Record Management


* Maintain, organize, and monitor electronic and paper medical records to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance.
* Review medical records for deficiencies, missing documentation, signature requirements, and documentation quality.
* Process record corrections, amendments, and updates in accordance with organizational policies and regulatory requirements.
* Support designated record set management and legal medical record maintenance.
* Conduct routine medical record quality reviews and audits.

Release of Information (ROI)


* Process patient, caregiver, provider, attorney, payer, auditor, and regulatory agency requests for records.
* Verify identity, authorization, and legal requirements prior to disclosure.
* Coordinate responses to subpoenas, audits, investigations, and regulatory inquiries.
* Maintain accurate disclosure logs and documentation of record releases.

Compliance and Risk Management


* Ensure compliance with HIPAA, state privacy laws, medical record retention requirements, accreditation standards, and organizational policies.
* Identify and escalate risks related to documentation, privacy, security, or record management practices.
* Participate in internal and external audits and corrective action activities.
* Support regulatory readiness and audit preparedness initiatives.

Data Integrity and Documentation Oversight


* Monitor data quality and documentation standards within electronic medical record systems.
* Assist departments with documentation questions, record requirements, and best practices.
* Identify trends, recurring deficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Support implementation of documentation standards and workflows.

Systems and Process Support


* Collaborate with Product Management, clinical teams, and operational teams regarding medical record functionality and improvements.
* Participate in testing, implementation, and optimization of record\-related workflows and technologies.
* Assist with document management, scanning, indexing, and records retention processes.

Education and Customer Service


* Provide guidance to staff regarding medical record requirements, release of information procedures, and privacy standards.
* Respond professionally and timely to internal and external record requests.
* Promote a culture of compliance, confidentiality, and quality documentation throughout the organization.

**Qualifications**

Minimum Education, Experience \& Training Equivalent to:


* High School Diploma/GED required; Bachelor's degree preferred.
* Minimum two (2\) years of experience in health information management, medical records, healthcare compliance, revenue cycle support, or related healthcare operations.
* Experience with electronic health record (EHR/EMR) systems required.
* Experience processing release of information requests preferred.
* Experience supporting audits, accreditation, quality, or payer requirements preferred.
* Certifications (Preferred):
	+ Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT)
	+ Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA)
	+ Certified Healthcare Privacy and Security (CHPS)
	+ Certified Professional in Healthcare Information and Management Systems (CPHIMS)

Additional Requirements:


* Knowledge of HIPAA privacy and security regulations.
* Knowledge of medical record standards, documentation requirements, and health information management principles.
* Understanding of healthcare regulatory and accreditation requirements.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to manage sensitive and confidential information.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and electronic health record systems.
* Ability to analyze records, identify deficiencies, and recommend corrective actions.

Requests:


* Must be able to communicate effectively within the work environment, read, and write using the primary language within the workplace.
* Visual and auditory ability to work with clients, staff, and others in the workplace continuously.
* Frequent speaking and listening (25\-75%) to clients, staff, and others in the workplace.
* Utilize computer and cell phone for effective communication.

**Knowledge, Skills \& Abilities (organized by our company values):**

Community oriented:


* Appreciates and demonstrates collaboration across teams.
* Serves as a role model, bringing our core values to life in your work.
* Work in an exciting, fast paced high energy environment while effectively multitasking and managing day\-to\-day responsibilities without supervision.
* Personable; able to work comfortably with individuals at all levels within the organization.
* Excellent verbal and writing communication skills; frequent proofreading and checking documents for accuracy.

Equity informed:


* Approaches work with a growth mindset, welcome feedback, and understand that humans all have biases and are imperfect as a baseline.
* Sensitivity to working with an ethnically, linguistically, culturally, and economically diverse population.

Bold:


* Navigates ambiguity with an excitement for problem solving.
* Commitment to meet agreed upon deadlines on time or ahead of schedule.
* Transparent on action, pursuits, and outcomes.
* A commitment to the values of the organization while demonstrating good judgment, flexibility, patience and discretion when dealing with confidential and sensitive matters.

Wellbeing driven:


* Willingness and commitment to self\-reflection and re\-thinking.
* Ability to understand your physical, mental, social, and financial wellbeing needs with a willingness to co\-create boundaries that allow you to sustainably show up and honor your humanity.
* Capacity to contribute to and help cultivate effective \+ sustainable wellbeing driven spaces.
* Commitment to managing a remote schedule that aligns with PST business hours, ensuring your availability supports a healthy team rhythm and effective cross\-functional partnership.

**Conditions of Employment**

* Ability to obtain and maintain criminal record clearance through the Department of Justice (DOJ). The People \& Performance Department must analyze DOJ/FBI live scan reports in accordance with applicable Federal, State, and Local laws, as well as fitness for the position.
* Ability to obtain and maintain clearance through the Office of Inspector General.
* Must attend any required training.

**Time Type:**

Full time
**Compensation:**
-----------------

$30\.00 \- $40\.00 Hourly
The statements contained in this job description reflect general details as necessary to describe the principal functions of this job. It should not be considered an all\-inclusive listing of work requirements. Individuals may perform other duties as assigned, including work in other functional areas as deemed fit for the organization.


Catalight is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: EMR Analyst II **Optime and Anesthesia** Remote
jobs.description:
**Why work at TidalHealth?**


Looking for a rewarding place to work? Choose TidalHealth, which now includes three hospitals – TidalHealth Peninsula Regional in Salisbury, Maryland; TidalHealth Nanticoke in Seaford, Delaware; and TidalHealth Atlantic in Berlin, Maryland. All three hospitals are “A” rated by Leapfrog Hospital Safety Guide, and the facilities have received numerous other honors.


TidalHealth is regularly adding new practices to grow our offerings in specialty and subspecialty services. These include neurosurgery, cardiothoracic surgery, joint replacement, emergency/trauma care, comprehensive cancer care, wound care, clinical trials and research, and more. TidalHealth is also home to a growing graduate medical education program to prepare the next generation of physician specialists.


Located on the beautiful Delmarva Peninsula, close to the beach, becoming part of Team TidalHealth also offers an ideal opportunity for work\-life balance. Take advantage of our tuition assistance and scholarship programs to grow both personally and professionally.


**EMR Analyst II Position Summary**


The EMR Analyst II provides analytical expertise in the development and implementation of system\-related clinical, access, revenue cycle, decision support and quality improvement applications. He / she will support new project development including system analysis, planning and preparation. Develop, support and maintain documentation and procedures as needed. Provide training to other IT staff and user clients as appropriate. Provides product function, design, and build expertise (obtains EMR module certification) and experience needed for successful product implementation. Supports all project team members with application and information systems knowledge. The Application Analyst is a member of the team of primary resources dedicated to designing, building, testing, and activating the application database. Develops and maintains models and documentation of business and system requirements and configures system accordingly. Documents and maintains all required system design and build documents. Contributes to preparation of testing scripts and materials and performs unit, system, and integrated testing tasks. Works with training team to develop application specific training curriculums and materials. Provides expertise and experience to the development of activation plans, application activation tasks, and production environment readiness. Logs, tracks, and resolves issues as well as any software code modifications or enhancements


**EMR Analyst II Position Requirements**


Required License and/or Certification


* Has EPIC certification in assigned modules


Education


* Bachelor’s degree preferred. Extensive work experience may be considered in lieu of educational requirements on a case\-by\-case basis.


Experience


* 3 years of relevant work experience in healthcare or similar fields.


**EMR Analyst II Work Schedule**


* Day shift, Monday through Friday with call. Overtime may be required.
* Expected to respond in the event of a disaster.


**EMR Analyst II Benefits**


* At TidalHealth, full\-time employees working at least 72 hours per pay period, part\-time employees working at least 36 hours per pay period and part\-time employees working at least 30 hours or more on weekends only are eligible for benefits.
* Benefits include medical, prescription, vision, dental, flexible spending accounts, disability insurance plans, life insurance, paid time off plans, retirement plans, tuition assistance, employee assistance, and access to on\-site childcare and a credit union.

  



  

Location: TidalHealth · Information Services\-TidalHealth Peninsula Regional  

Schedule: Full Time, Monday \- Friday, 8:00\-4:30pm

jobs.title: Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Circadia Health**



Circadia Health is a growth\-stage healthcare AI company on a mission to prevent avoidable hospitalizations and transform senior\-care operations. Our Circadia Intelligence Platform combines:


* Contactless sensing that monitors respiration and motion with medical\-grade accuracy
* Native predictive models that detect 85% of preventable adverse events several days in advance
* Enterprise integrations that operationalize predictions directly inside EHR, care\-coordination, billing, and compliance workflows

Today, our technology touches 40,000\+ post\-acute patients daily across skilled\-nursing, home\-health, and home\-care networks. We are backed by leading healthcare and AI investors and headquartered in El Segundo, CA.

**What You'll Do**
------------------


**Implementation and Support**


* Lead on\-site implementation of Circadia's monitoring platform in SNFs, from device installation through go\-live, integrating it into existing care routines rather than adding a parallel process.
* Assess each facility before rollout: shift patterns, unit layout, staffing model, EHR workflow, and connectivity constraints.
* Build and execute the facility implementation plan with clear owners, dates, and dependencies, keeping it current as conditions change.
* Serve as first\-line support after launch: troubleshoot devices and connectivity, resolve staff questions, and escalate product issues with enough detail for Engineering to act.
* Track device uptime and utilization by facility, unit, and shift, and flag gaps before the customer does.


**Training and Adoption**


* Deliver training to clinical and frontline staff across all shifts, including nights and weekends, where adoption gaps usually live.
* Tailor content and delivery to the audience. CNAs, nurses, DONs, unit managers, and facility IT each need a different version.
* Build and maintain training materials and a knowledge base that hold up after you leave the building.
* Identify the behavioral reason adoption is lagging rather than defaulting to another session, and retrain where retraining is the actual fix.
* Develop facility champions and super\-users so competence survives staff turnover.


**Relationship Management and Collaboration**


* Build working trust with facility teams at every level, from the floor to the administrator, so staff surface issues early.
* Coordinate with in\-house care teams and remote clinical providers so the customer experiences one program, not several.
* Participate in interdisciplinary team meetings, contributing implementation insight and ensuring device data is used inside patient care plans.
* Partner with Customer Success, Clinical, Support, and Engineering to unblock deployments, and own customer\-facing communication while a dependency is open.
* Hand off to Customer Success with a documented account state: utilization baseline, stakeholder map, and open risks.


**Quality Improvement and Compliance**


* Feed field evidence to Product and Engineering: failure modes, workflow friction, and what staff actually do with the product.
* Ensure all activity complies with regulatory standards and patient safety guidelines.
* Maintain accurate documentation of implementation activity, staff education, and device functionality checks, aligned to organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Follow facility protocols on HIPAA, infection control, and site access.

**Qualifications**
------------------



**Must\-have**


* Bachelor's degree in business, operations, healthcare administration, nursing, or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience in a healthcare setting.
* Comfort operating inside healthcare environments, particularly skilled nursing facilities, with working knowledge of nursing workflows, shift structure, and floor dynamics.
* Clear, confident verbal and written communication with the ability to train and hold a room of clinical staff.
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build credibility quickly with audiences ranging from CNAs to facility administrators.
* Practical problem\-solving: you diagnose the cause on site rather than escalating it as\-is.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, managing your own schedule, follow\-up, and commitments across multiple facilities at once.
* Organizational rigor with project tracking tools such as Monday.com. Nothing lives only in your head.
* Willingness to travel up to 75%, including early mornings and occasional overnight shift coverage.


**Preferred**


* Experience implementing healthcare technology, remote patient monitoring, or telehealth services in provider settings.
* Clinical background or license (RN, LPN, RT, CNA) or direct post\-acute operations experience.
* Experience training frontline staff in high\-turnover environments.


As a full\-time **Implementation Specialist,** you will be employed by Circadia Health, Inc. The anticipated annual base salary range for this full\-time position is $75,000 \- $100,000\. The base range is determined by role and level, and placement within the range will depend on a number of job\-related factors, including but not limited to your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.



Annual salary is only one part of an employee's total compensation package at Circadia Health. We also offer:


* Company\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage
* 401(k)
* Competitive time off with pay policies including vacation, sick days, and company holidays
* Impact: your work will influence care decisions for tens of thousands of seniors every day.
* Culture: hard\-working, mission\-driven, and collaborative — with weekly and monthly social events like yoga, beach bonfires, and Wednesday/Friday team lunches.

Circadia Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
